tools.name: get_info
tools.description: Everything about Alexey Sound, a production sound mixer / location sound recordist in Dubai: services, price (from AED 2,500/day), kit, FAQ, credits, reviews, contacts.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Availability is not published. Returns how to ask for given dates.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Send a booking request to Alexey for the client. It is NOT a confirmation: Alexey replies to the client personally. Ask the client for every required field first.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_info · Private data: get_info · Public sink: request_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_info · Private data: get_info · Public sink: request_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
